The '''Ardroxia system''' was located in the [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the [[Ardroxian Flu]].<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Ardroxian Flu]]|system=Ardroxia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ardroxia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square R-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
